ckd_guidelines.stage_1: eGFR ≥90 with kidney damage. Annual monitoring, control diabetes/hypertension.
ckd_guidelines.stage_2: eGFR 60-89 with kidney damage. Monitor every 6-12 months.
ckd_guidelines.stage_3a: eGFR 45-59. Monitor every 6 months, nephrology referral.
ckd_guidelines.stage_3b: eGFR 30-44. Monitor every 3-6 months, prepare for advanced care.
ckd_guidelines.stage_4: eGFR 15-29. Prepare for renal replacement therapy.

symptom_analysis.fluid_retention: Monitor for swelling in legs, shortness of breath
symptom_analysis.anemia: Fatigue, pale skin may indicate low hemoglobin
symptom_analysis.cardiovascular: Chest pain, irregular heartbeat need immediate attention
